text:
maya: Heads up — running the sampleapp with the connector cache turned on causes the client-side queue to balloon and streaming requests to hang. Repro on staging.

sam: Can you paste repro steps?

maya: Quick repro: 1) enable `connector_cache: true` in sampleapp config 2) set prefetch window=10 3) run `ab -c 50` against /stream endpoint. After ~30s inflight climbs and workers block.

maya: Logs:```
WARN runtime: inflight=256 waiting=1024 kv_cache_hits=12
ERROR runtime: lease_timeout waiting for permit (held by retry)
```

jordan: That smells like a holdback TTL + prefetch cursor retention issue. Is this JS-only or seen in Python too?

maya: Only observed in the JS sampleapp so far. Python sample doesn't enable the cache connector by default.

tia: Could also be an auth/retry interaction — if a token refresh triggers a 401 path that retries without releasing the client permit, permits stack up.

ops-eli: Also check connector eviction settings. Default TTL is 5m; for short-lived streaming sessions that can hold resources way too long.

maya: I put a quick change locally: set cache_ttl=30s and wrap lease acquire/release in a `try/finally` to guarantee release on all retry paths. Local staging looked stable after that.

sam: Nice. Can you open a short PR with the `try/finally` and a config flag? I'll review.

maya: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/987 (WIP) — adds `connectorCache.ttl` and ensures `lease.release()` in finally.

devex-bot: Issue created: #4321-client-cache-holdback (assigned to jordan) — https://issues.redwood.ai/4321

jordan: I'll pick this up. Plan: 1) add unit test to sdk-js that simulates a 401 during streaming and asserts permit release, 2) add an integration canary in staging with reduced TTL, 3) add telemetry counter for "permits_held_on_retry".

ops-eli: For the canary, set connectorCache.ttl=15s and prefetchWindow=5 to stress. Keep an eye on token refresh metrics.

sam: Also let's add a short doc blurb under devex about recommended cache_ttl defaults for streaming vs request/response: streaming=15-30s, rr=5m+.

maya: Agreed. I'll update the sampleapp README in the PR.

jordan: ETA end of day tomorrow for the test + canary.

sam: Thanks all :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — will follow up in the issue with logs and metrics dump.
